testCases.scenario: AC1: a valid user can sign in and lands on the product list
testCases.testCase: Sign in as standard_user and reach the product list
testCases.preCondition: Browser open at https://www.saucedemo.com/; the demo account 'standard_user' is not locked
testSteps: Enter the shared demo password into the Password field
testCases.testData:
Username: standard_user
Password: (SAUCEDEMO_PASSWORD, defaults to the published demo password)
testCases.expectedResult: App navigates to /inventory.html and the 'Products' heading is visible
testCases.linkedTestTitle: SAUCE-001-POS-01 — a standard user reaches the product list

testCases.scenario: AC1: a locked-out account is refused with a clear message
testCases.testCase: Sign in as locked_out_user and see the lock-out error
testCases.preCondition: Browser open at https://www.saucedemo.com/; the demo account 'locked_out_user' is locked by design
testSteps: Enter the shared demo password into the Password field
testCases.testData:
Username: locked_out_user
Password: (SAUCEDEMO_PASSWORD, defaults to the published demo password)
testCases.expectedResult: Stays on the sign-in page and shows 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'
testCases.linkedTestTitle: SAUCE-001-NEG-01 — a locked-out user is rejected
